title: Design System: PLOVER — The Dark Foundry

display.purpose: Hero headlines, page titles. Ultra-light, massive scale.

headline.purpose: Section titles, product names. Light weight.

mono.purpose: Technical specifications, DN/PN values, precision data.

components.name: Primary Button (Gold CTA)
components.description: The highest-contrast button. Amber-gold on void. Use for Submit, Send, Browse, Contact, Learn More.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C8A96E; color: #0A0F1A; padding: 14px 32px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E5C98A; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #9A7D4B; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with gold border and text. Use for Contact Us, View All.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #C8A96E; padding: 14px 32px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.3); border-radius: 8px; transition: background 400ms, border-color 400ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(200,169,110,0.1); border-color: rgba(200,169,110,0.5); }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Dark surface card with hairline gold border. Border brightens on hover.
components.html:
Gate Valve DN50

PN16 · Cast Iron
components.css: .ds-card-product { background: #141B2D; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.08); overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 400ms, box-shadow 400ms; } .ds-card-product:hover { border-color: rgba(200,169,110,0.2); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(200,169,110,0.08); } .ds-card-image { aspect-ratio: 1; background: #1A2332; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-cover; transition: opacity 500ms; } .ds-card-product:hover .ds-card-image img { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-card-body { padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 400; font-size: 1rem; color: #F0F2F5; } .ds-card-title:hover { color: #C8A96E; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94A3B8; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dark surface-raised background, gold-tinted border, gold glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; background: #1A2332; border: 1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.12); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1rem; color: #F0F2F5; transition: border-color 400ms, box-shadow 400ms; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748B; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(200,169,110,0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(200,169,110,0.1); }

components.name: Technical Data Table
components.description: Monospace labels and values on dark surface. Gold-tinted row borders.
components.css: .ds-specs { divide-y: rgba(200,169,110,0.05); } .ds-spec-row { display: flex; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.05); } .ds-specs dt { font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #94A3B8; width: 40%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-specs dd { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #F0F2F5; }

components.name: Gold Divider
components.description: The signature section divider. 48px gold line.

components.name: Section Header
components.description: Ultra-light title + gold gradient line divider.
components.css: .ds-section-title { font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 3rem); font-weight: 300; color: #F0F2F5; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-section-line { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(200,169,110,0.3), transparent); } .ds-section-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 32px; }

narrative.overview:
PLOVER's digital presence reads like a high-end automotive configurator crossed with a precision engineering atelier. The world is dark by default — deep navy-black surfaces (#0A0F1A) that make product imagery pop with cinematic intensity. Every surface is intentional: gunmetal cards float on the void with subtle gold borders, technical data glows in monospace precision, and the amber-gold accent (#C8A96E) is the single warm pulse in an otherwise cool, controlled environment.

Typography is the silent hero. Ultra-light display weights (200-300) at massive scale create an editorial, almost luxury-fashion sensibility. Body text is clean and widely-led for long-form technical reading. Monospace is reserved exclusively for specifications — DN values, pressure ratings, temperatures — where precision reads as credibility.

Motion is slow and deliberate. Transitions ease out over 400-600ms. Elements fade and drift rather than snap. Nothing jitters, nothing rushes.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-by-default — Deep navy-black void (#0A0F1A) as the canvas, not an afterthought.
Gold as punctuation — Amber-gold (#C8A96E) appears only on interactive elements and key data.
Cinematic scale — Product imagery at full-bleed, headlines at 5rem+, whitespace as luxury.
Monospace precision — Technical data in mono font signals engineering credibility.
Subtle glow, not shadow — Depth via faint gold borders and ambient glow, not drop shadows.

rules.name: The Gold Pulse Rule
rules.body: Amber-gold appears only on elements that demand action or convey precision: CTAs, form focuses, active nav indicators, technical specifications, and thin decorative dividers. It never fills large surfaces.

rules.name: The Void Rule
rules.body: White and light backgrounds are not part of this system. The only light surfaces are text (Snow) and imagery. If a surface is lighter than #1A2332, it's either an image or an error.

rules.name: The Lightness Rule
rules.body: Display and Headline weights never exceed 300. Bold headlines are a different brand. Increase size or add gold color for emphasis — never weight.

rules.name: The Mono Boundary Rule
rules.body: Monospace is used ONLY for technical data values and code-like content. Never for body text, navigation, or buttons.

rules.name: The Gold Line Rule
rules.body: Every card, every container is defined by a hairline gold border at low opacity. Precision through line, not depth through shadow.

dos: Do keep the void (#0A0F1A) as the primary background on every page.
Do use gold (#C8A96E) exclusively for CTAs, focus states, active indicators, and technical data.
Do use ultra-light display weights (200-300) for headlines — never bold.
Do define cards and containers with hairline gold borders, not shadows.
Do use monospace font for all technical specification values.
Do give elements generous room to breathe — whitespace is luxury.
donts: Don't use white or light backgrounds (except for text and images).
Don't use gold as a surface fill color — only for lines, text, and small interactive elements.
Don't use font weights above 500 for UI elements, above 300 for headlines.
Don't use drop shadows for depth — use gold borders and ambient glow instead.
Don't use monospace for body text, navigation, or buttons — only for technical data.
Don't crowd the layout — the dark canvas needs breathing room.
Don't use rounded corners above 12px — precision over softness.
